idea_name: Active B3 futures contract resolver by month-code and expiration
mechanism: CurrentSymbol reads the chart prefix (first 3 chars), matches enum {WIN,IND,WDO,DOL}, picks the contract month-code string (DOL/WDO: FGHJKMNQUVXZ; IND/WIN: GJMQVZ), then walks year/month candidates StringFormat("%s%s%d", prefix, monthCode, yy) until SYMBOL_EXPIRATION_TIME is still in the future—always resolving to the currently active series, never past or multi-expiry-ahead contracts.
data_needed: Chart _Symbol prefix; TimeCurrent calendar; SymbolInfoInteger(..., SYMBOL_EXPIRATION_TIME) for each candidate ticker
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: B3 futures WIN/IND (index) and WDO/DOL (dollar); monthly dollar series (~20 trading days) used as extreme case; chart TF is whatever the trader uses for indicators (e.g. 20-period MA); commodities/S&P/euro mentioned as extensible
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a deterministic instrument-identity sensor for rolled futures: map any historical/continuous chart symbol to the live tradeable contract without hard-coding expiry calendars.
quote: the procedure scans through the possible futures contracts until it locates the active one.

idea_name: Mini↔full cross-order on continuous historical futures chart
mechanism: Enum assigns minis even (WIN=0,WDO=2) and fulls odd (IND=1,DOL=3). CurrentSymbol(bUsingFull) uses (eTS&1) plus ±1 to swap mini↔full while keeping the same month-code walk, so a historical DOL (or WDO) continuous chart can route orders to the opposite contract size. Chart Trade input eTypeContract {MINI,FULL} passes the bool into C_Terminal; the trade payload also sends GetInfoTerminal().szSymbol (resolved contract) alongside _Symbol (chart). Motivated by indicators resetting every monthly series expiry on dollar futures.
data_needed: Trader choice mini vs full; resolved szSymbol tick size/value/volume step for finance↔points; chart historical series of either contract
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: WDO↔DOL and WIN↔IND on B3; dollar futures monthly expiry called out; long-horizon MAs (e.g. 20-period) on charts that would otherwise reset each series
why_new_for_mis: Separates sensing chart (continuous/historical series for indicators) from execution symbol (active mini or full)—a roll-continuity pattern MIS can reuse so regime/vol features do not restart at each futures expiry.
quote: By the time the moving average is fully calculated and plotted, the contract expires and resets with a new series.

idea_name: Chart Trade↔EA custom-event handshake for contract type
mechanism: Adds evChartTrade_At_EA / evEA_At_ChartTrade; on CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE Chart Trade pings the EA; EA replies with user00 MINI/FULL (0/1) or -1 on remove so Chart Trade calls CurrentSymbol and hides order buttons when EA absent. Load-order and timeframe-reload races are the focus—UI/IPC plumbing, not a market-state sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same B3 WIN/IND/WDO/DOL cross-order context; no TF-specific sensing
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—EA/indicator messaging and button visibility only.
quote: when any object - indicator or Expert Advisor - is added to the chart, MetaTrader 5 triggers a CHARTEVENT_CHART_CHANGE event.

idea_name: MT5 service writing D1 closes to CSV for Excel refresh
mechanism: C_ShareAtExcel service reads symbol list from Quote.csv, loops every N seconds writing symbol;iClose(symbol,PERIOD_D1,0) with FILE_SHARE_WRITE so Excel Power Query can refresh ~60s. Mentions long/short book quote hygiene and GoogleFinance delays—data export for risk sheets, not regime/vol/liquidity sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example PETR4, VALE3, ITUB3; iClose on PERIOD_D1; Excel refresh ≥1 minute
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—file-bridge plumbing from MT5 to Excel only.

idea_name: Python COM LinkMT5Excel socket server shell
mechanism: LinkMT5Excel binds a TCP server, attaches to Excel.Application via win32com, authenticates clients with header <mt5 with excel>, writes online/offline status into relative cells, and relays cell content+[CMD] to MT5. Infrastructure for fundamental-analysis Excel control of MT5—no sensing algorithm.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic Excel cell symbol (e.g. later WDON23); no TF sensor built here
